entries.title: John 16:1
segments: ¶"These things I have spoken to you, that you should not be made to stumble.

entries.title: John 16:2
segments: "They will put you out of the synagogues; yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers God service.

entries.title: John 16:3
segments: "And these things they will do to you because they have not known the Father nor Me.

entries.title: John 16:4
segments: "But these things I have told you, that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you of them. And these things I did not say to you at the beginning, because I was with you.

entries.title: John 16:5
segments: "But now I go away to Him who sent Me, and none of you asks Me, 'Where are You going?'

entries.title: John 16:6
segments: "But because I have said these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart.

entries.title: John 16:7
segments: ¶"Nevertheless I tell you the truth. It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I do not go away, the Helper will not come to you; but if I depart, I will send Him to you.

entries.title: John 16:8
segments: "And when He has come, He will convict the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

entries.title: John 16:9
segments: "of sin, because they do not believe in Me;

entries.title: John 16:10
segments: "of righteousness, because I go to My Father and you see Me no more;

entries.title: John 16:11
segments: "of judgment, because the ruler of this world is judged.

entries.title: John 16:12
segments: "I still have many things to say to you, but you cannot bear [them] now.

entries.title: John 16:13
segments: "However, when He, the Spirit of truth, has come, He will guide you into all truth; for He will not speak on His own [authority], but whatever He hears He will speak; and He will tell you things to come.

entries.title: John 16:14
segments: "He will glorify Me, for He will take of what is Mine and declare [it] to you.

entries.title: John 16:15
segments: "All things that the Father has are Mine. Therefore I said that He will take of Mine and declare [it] to you.

entries.title: John 16:16
segments: ¶"A little while, and you will not see Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me, because I go to the Father."

entries.title: John 16:17
segments: Then [some] of His disciples said among themselves, "What is this that He says to us, 'A little while, and you will not see Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me'; and, 'because I go to the Father'?"

entries.title: John 16:18
segments: They said therefore, "What is this that He says, 'A little while'? We do not know what He is saying."

entries.title: John 16:19
segments: Now Jesus knew that they desired to ask Him, and He said to them, "Are you inquiring among yourselves about what I said, 'A little while, and you will not see Me; and again a little while, and you will see Me'?

entries.title: John 16:20
segments: "Most assuredly, I say to you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice; and you will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

entries.title: John 16:21
segments: "A woman, when she is in labor, has sorrow because her hour has come; but as soon as she has given birth to the child, she no longer remembers the anguish, for joy that a human being has been born into the world.

entries.title: John 16:22
segments: "Therefore you now have sorrow; but I will see you again and your heart will rejoice, and your joy no one will take from you.

entries.title: John 16:23
segments: ¶"And in that day you will ask Me nothing. Most assuredly, I say to you, whatever you ask the Father in My name He will give you.

entries.title: John 16:24
segments: "Until now you have asked nothing in My name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be full.

entries.title: John 16:25
segments: "These things I have spoken to you in figurative language; but the time is coming when I will no longer speak to you in figurative language, but I will tell you plainly about the Father.

entries.title: John 16:26
segments: "In that day you will ask in My name, and I do not say to you that I shall pray the Father for you;

entries.title: John 16:27
segments: "for the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me, and have believed that I came forth from God.

entries.title: John 16:28
segments: ¶"I came forth from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father."

entries.title: John 16:29
segments: His disciples said to Him, "See, now You are speaking plainly, and using no figure of speech!

entries.title: John 16:30
segments: "Now we are sure that You know all things, and have no need that anyone should question You. By this we believe that You came forth from God."

entries.title: John 16:31
segments: Jesus answered them, "Do you now believe?

entries.title: John 16:32
segments: "Indeed the hour is coming, yes, has now come, that you will be scattered, each to his own, and will leave Me alone. And yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.

entries.title: John 16:33
segments: "These things I have spoken to you, that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation; but be of good cheer, I have overcome the world."
